content:
I need a vent chat so bad... I'm so grateful to have climbing, it's a great way to let my frustrations out. I won't post the vent stuff here tonight. But man do I need to sort shit out. 

Something I think I missed posting but JJ and Chloe both lost a tooth on the same day. That was pretty cool. 

JJ has to speak in front of the school tomorrow. I'm so proud that he even put his hand up for it. He's so brave. I don't know if he realizes what he got himself into. He has to read in front of the school and his reading skills are not great... I really wish him luck. Just the fact he put his hand up and practiced at home is a gold star in my book. Trying is the real win.
